properties.summary: Proposed land use, nothing approved: the six land-use classes of the revised SDC Campus Specific Plan traced from Figure 4 (Specific Plan Update Land Use Diagram, p. 22) of the County of Sonoma's Notice of Preparation (SCH 2025081410, Aug 2025), with the two Employment areas named from Figure 5 (the Eldridge Renewal site plan) and the NOP text, and the wildfire buffer as the project area outside the core campus. Streets, drawn white in the figure, are left out of the zones (about 17 of the core campus's 159 acres as drawn). The 2022 specific plan, rescinded in December 2024, is not drawn. No buildings are drawn; all zone edges are approximate.
properties.note: Proposed land use from the county's 2025 Notice of Preparation; nothing is approved. Approximate zones, not buildings.

properties.label: Proposed low/medium density residential
properties.source: traced: SDC Campus Specific Plan Update and Eldridge Renewal Project Notice of Preparation (County of Sonoma, SCH 2025081410, Aug 2025), Figure 4, Specific Plan Update Land Use Diagram, p. 22
properties.note: Figure 4's lower-density housing district. The NOP doesn't assign housing types to districts; it describes 368 detached homes (courtyard, hillside, large and small) in compact neighbourhoods throughout the core campus (p. 8). The NOP gives typical heights of two to three stories for apartments, mixed-use buildings and townhomes, one to three for detached homes and three for co-housing (pp. 7-8); it doesn't tie heights to districts. About 47.5 acres as drawn, streets excluded. Approximate: traced from the county's figure. Proposed, not approved.

properties.label: Proposed medium/flex density residential
properties.source: traced: SDC Campus Specific Plan Update and Eldridge Renewal Project Notice of Preparation (County of Sonoma, SCH 2025081410, Aug 2025), Figure 4, Specific Plan Update Land Use Diagram, p. 22
properties.note: Figure 4's higher-density housing district. The NOP doesn't assign housing types to districts; it places townhomes along Arnold Drive, at the east end of the Central Green and north and south of the Main Building (p. 7). The NOP gives typical heights of two to three stories for apartments, mixed-use buildings and townhomes, one to three for detached homes and three for co-housing (pp. 7-8); it doesn't tie heights to districts. About 22.2 acres as drawn, streets excluded. Approximate: traced from the county's figure. Proposed, not approved.

properties.label: Proposed flex zone
properties.source: traced: SDC Campus Specific Plan Update and Eldridge Renewal Project Notice of Preparation (County of Sonoma, SCH 2025081410, Aug 2025), Figure 4, Specific Plan Update Land Use Diagram, p. 22
properties.note: Apartments and mixed-use buildings with ground-floor commercial uses around the Central Green and major streets, grouped around the Central Green (NOP pp. 7-8). Category mixed-use: housing with ground-floor commercial uses. The NOP gives typical heights of two to three stories for apartments, mixed-use buildings and townhomes, one to three for detached homes and three for co-housing (pp. 7-8); it doesn't tie heights to districts. About 14.0 acres as drawn, streets excluded. Approximate: traced from the county's figure. Proposed, not approved.

properties.label: Proposed employment: hotel and conference center
properties.source: traced: SDC Campus Specific Plan Update and Eldridge Renewal Project Notice of Preparation (County of Sonoma, SCH 2025081410, Aug 2025), Figure 4, Specific Plan Update Land Use Diagram, p. 22
properties.note: A 150-key boutique hotel with conference facilities, amenities and a parking structure in the north-west of the core campus, about 120,000 sq ft in all (NOP pp. 7, 9; named on Figure 5, p. 23). Category commercial: visitor-serving. About 4.1 acres as drawn, streets excluded. Approximate: traced from the county's figure. Proposed, not approved.

properties.label: Proposed employment: Main Building and innovation center
properties.source: traced: SDC Campus Specific Plan Update and Eldridge Renewal Project Notice of Preparation (County of Sonoma, SCH 2025081410, Aug 2025), Figure 4, Specific Plan Update Land Use Diagram, p. 22
properties.note: The historic Main Building, reused for office, retail and entertainment, and the Small Business + Innovation Center behind it (two reused shops and three new buildings for office, R&D, creative services and micro-manufacturing) (NOP pp. 8-9; named on Figure 5, p. 23). Category office. About 130,000 sq ft of commercial uses project-wide (p. 7). About 4.0 acres as drawn, streets excluded. Approximate: traced from the county's figure. Proposed, not approved.

properties.label: Proposed park
properties.source: traced: SDC Campus Specific Plan Update and Eldridge Renewal Project Notice of Preparation (County of Sonoma, SCH 2025081410, Aug 2025), Figure 4, Specific Plan Update Land Use Diagram, p. 22
properties.note: Parks, including the Central Green. The NOP gives about 67 acres of parks, recreation areas and open space in all, with walking trails, sports fields, playgrounds, dog parks, a community center and gym, and riparian corridors (p. 7). About 9.9 acres as drawn, streets excluded. Approximate: traced from the county's figure. Proposed, not approved.

properties.label: Proposed open space
properties.source: traced: SDC Campus Specific Plan Update and Eldridge Renewal Project Notice of Preparation (County of Sonoma, SCH 2025081410, Aug 2025), Figure 4, Specific Plan Update Land Use Diagram, p. 22
properties.note: Open space along Sonoma Creek and Mill Creek, where the plan would set riparian setbacks (NOP p. 6). The NOP gives about 67 acres of parks, recreation and open space in all (p. 7). About 40.3 acres as drawn, streets excluded. Approximate: traced from the county's figure. Proposed, not approved.

properties.label: Proposed wildfire buffer
properties.source: traced: SDC Campus Specific Plan Update and Eldridge Renewal Project Notice of Preparation (County of Sonoma, SCH 2025081410, Aug 2025), Figure 4, Specific Plan Update Land Use Diagram, p. 22
properties.note: Managed open space ringing the core campus on the west, north and east: defensible space with fuel-management rules and protection for the Sonoma Valley Wildlife Corridor (NOP pp. 3, 6; 49 acres). Drawn as the project area outside Figure 4's core campus line. About 48.5 acres as drawn, streets excluded. Approximate: traced from the county's figure. Proposed, not approved.
